meta.description: 6 Halloween episodes of Regular Show. The Terror Tales of the Park Halloween anthologies.

videos.title: Terror Tales of the Park
videos.name: Terror Tales of the Park
videos.overview: Mordecai and Rigby discover an old Victorian Doll that Pops has not played with or seen since he was a child and unwittingly unleash its pent up rage against him. Muscle Man and High Five Ghost want to crash an old RV into a pit.

videos.overview: The group passes time by telling each other scary stories while driving to a Halloween party. "Payback" Mordecai's deceased uncle haunts him after accidentally knocking him into the ball return at a bowling alley.
